atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Use the @tailwind directive to insert Tailwind's base, components, and utilities styles into your CSS. This directive is valid for Tailwind CSS v3.x.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use @apply to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS. This directive is valid for all versions of Tailwind CSS.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Use the @layer directive to tell Tailwind which "bucket" a set of custom styles belong to. Valid layers are base, components, and utilities.

atDirectives.name: @import
atDirectives.description: Standard CSS @import directive for importing external stylesheets.
